title: Cabaret Law oversight and Office of Nightlife hearing

issue: Cabaret Law repeal or reform, an Office of Nightlife, and safer relationships between cultural spaces, communities, and City agencies

source.title: Hearing transcript: Enforcement of New York City's Cabaret Law

transcriptionPolicy: Speaker turns are normalized from the official Council transcript by removing line numbers and repeating page furniture, joining line-wrap hyphenation, and otherwise retaining transcript wording, uncertainty markers, and apparent errors. Display names do not silently amend the official text.
classificationPolicy: Every detected public witness received a position disposition after close reading. Supportive and partly supportive speakers include every attributed turn, including answers to questions; unresolved generic labels remain census-only.
scopeBoundary: The corpus includes speakers who supported full repeal, legal dancing, the proposed Office of Nightlife, or related safety and mediation reforms. Support for one part does not imply support for every proposal discussed.

defaultClassificationBasis.supportive: Close reading found affirmative support for Cabaret Law repeal, legal dancing, an Office of Nightlife, or related cultural-space safety reform.
defaultClassificationBasis.supports-in-part: Close reading found affirmative support for at least one reform Jamie and the coalition championed, without treating that support as agreement with every proposal.
defaultClassificationBasis.neutral-procedural: The attributed turns perform hearing administration rather than state an issue position.
defaultClassificationBasis.unclear: The record does not support a safely attributed position.
